pairs.l: 1 — Just look at the colours — red always means not allowed.
pairs.r: F — It's as simple as that.

pairs.l: 2 — The streets are busy. It's a pity I'm on duty.
3 — I have a backache. I should've asked Tom for help. Now it's too late.
pairs.r: E — The damage has been done.

pairs.l: 4 — Working nine to five isn't attractive — always the same, little creativity.
pairs.r: A — I don't like routines in my job.

pairs.l: 5 — Don't worry about the project. You can finish it or ask Peter for help.
pairs.r: B — There are some options available.

r1.exp: Poruka 1 (samo pogledaj boje — tako jednostavno) = F (It's as simple as that). Poruka 2 (mora raditi na državni praznik) = C (I have to work). Poruka 3 (trebao je pitati za pomoć, ali sad je kasno) = E (The damage has been done). Poruka 4 (ne voli rutinu i jednoličnost posla) = A (I don't like routines). Poruka 5 (ne brini, imaš opcije) = B (There are some options available).

r6.exp: 'Catching the 6.15' = hvatanje vlaka u 6:15. 'Goes straight there' = ide direktno → C (By train).

r7.exp: 'Would you please fill in the questionnaire... so we might have YOUR VIEW on this matter?' → traže mišljenje = A (To ask for an opinion).

r8.exp: 'We're flying out next week to finish it. It should take about 8 weeks.' → bit će u Indiji (u inozemstvu) = B (Because he will be abroad).

r9.exp: 'We agreed to share responsibilities', pizza na sofi, buka, 'start looking for a new place' → poruka je za cimera = A (His flatmate).

r10.exp: 'When I was ADMITTED', 'condition is improving', 'insurance might not cover expenses' → u bolnici = C (At hospital).

r11.exp: 'My first language is GERMAN' → materinski jezik je njemački, dakle podrijetlom je iz Njemačke = C.

r12.exp: 'I love nature. You can ski in the winter and take walks in the summer' — opis kuće u Alpama (planine). Obiteljska kuća je nasljedstvo u Alpama = A.

r13.exp: 'He started to BLOG, which made him a public face' → blog ga je učinio poznatim = C.

r14.exp: 'I do consulting for a lot of fashion companies' — to je sadašnje zanimanje = B (Fashion consultant).

r15.exp: 'The BEST of his ideas DEFINITELY come from films' → filmovi su najveća inspiracija = A.

r16.exp: 'Develop your skills, to be well-prepared (16)____.' → D: when you start auditioning. Priprema je važna za audicije.

r17.exp: 'Want agents to be sure (17)____.' → C: that you have experience performing. 'Be sure that...' — imenička surečenica.

r18.exp: 'Need parents' permission; (18)____.' → B: therefore, it's important to get their support. Logičan zaključak — trebaš dobiti podršku roditelja.

r19.exp: 'When you're confident enough, (19)____. Talk about it as much as you can.' → F: show them how much it means to you. Pokaži roditeljima koliko ti to znači.

r20.exp: 'Have good reasons; you love stories, creating characters, (20)____.' → A: so they'll take you seriously. Dobri razlozi = ozbiljno će te shvatiti.

r21.exp: 'See their face LIGHT UP with a smile' — frazalni glagol: light up = obasjati se, razvedriti se (o licu).

r22.exp: 'Since the 19th century... HAS BEEN USED' — present perfect passive za radnju koja je počela u prošlosti i traje do danas ('since').

r23.exp: 'May help with mathematics, ALTHOUGH more studies are needed' — 'although' = iako (kontrast/ograđivanje).

r24.exp: 'BEFORE you can achieve meditation, folding needs to become automatic' — 'before' = prije nego. Najprije automatizacija, tek onda meditacija.

r25.exp: 'Practise LETTING GO of perfectionism' — 'practise' zahtijeva gerund (letting). Practise + gerund.

r26.exp: 'Millennials WERE born from 1980 to 1994' — past simple passive za definiranu generaciju u prošlosti.

r27.exp: 'Statistics TELL us' — 'tell' zahtijeva neizravni objekt (tell someone something). Statistics tell us = statistike nam govore.

r28.exp: 'EITHER own a smartphone OR have access to one' — disjunktivni veznik: either... or.

r29.exp: 'Use THEIR internet-connected devices' — posvojna zamjenica: their se odnosi na Zoomers (Gen Z).

r30.exp: 'The good news is THAT half of Gen Z prefers...' — imenička surečenica s 'that' kao spojnicom.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) gdje si zadnji put bio/la na odmoru i zašto, (2) što si radio/la i kakvo je bilo, (3) što Peter treba vidjeti u Hrvatskoj i zašto. Dužina 80–100 riječi. Neformalan registar.

w1.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (80–100 riječi). Napomena: od 2023. minimalna dužina je 80 riječi.
